reasons.claim: 7.75 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

One eligible species is recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, lichen, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of continuity forest and lack of large or old trees). Its nearest record is 44 m from the polygon edge (2026, unc 25 m; 4 records in total). This gives HIGH under the rubric.

Site-bound NT species are also recorded close by: Cystostereum murrayi (41 m, 2026) and Bryoria nadvornikiana (70 m, 2026). Neither is eligible alone. Two further VU eligible species are recorded at 749-901 m: Phellopilus nigrolimitatus and Skeletocutis brevispora.
Near-site effort: 3 records within 250 m (county median 3), 0 inside. Effort within 1000 m is below the county median (51 records versus 66).

uncertainties: Records are outside the polygon (nearest 41-70 m), so presence on the felled stand itself is not shown.
The nearest VU record has 25 m coordinate uncertainty, which is small relative to the site's 157 m equivalent radius.
Effort within 1000 m is below the county median, so the picture may be incomplete. One coarse record within 250 m was excluded.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
Habitat quality or age of the stand.
Legality of the felling or any causal effect of it on the species recorded.
next_action: Prioritise for human ecological review before the felling start date. Use a field survey of the polygon and its edge for the VU lichen Alectoria sarmentosa and the nearby NT fungi and lichens, with attention to the 2026 records within about 70 m.
